messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: genqueue-throttle — us-west. Error rate and queue depth increasing. Severity: P1. Runbook: https://redwood.runbooks/genqueue-throttle. Oncall: @aya. Please ack and start mitigation.
aya (oncall): Ack. I'm on it, taking lead. Will collect impact and post a status page draft in ~10m.
sre-james: digging in now — seeing sustained KV cache miss spikes on 3 nodes (g4dn pool). backlog growing, autoscale not triggering due to quota.
aya (oncall): quick mitigation: scaling extra genqueue workers and temporarily lowering max-batch-size to reduce queue depth. Drafting initial status page copy below — feedback pls.
aya (oncall): ```
We are investigating elevated request latency and throttling affecting text generation in the us-west region. Users may see delayed completions or rate-limit-like errors.
Impact: ~7-12% of requests degraded; embeddings not impacted at this time.
Mitigation: Scaling serving pool and applying throttling safeguards to reduce queue pressure.
Next update: in 30 minutes or sooner as we have new info.
```
support-maya: copy ok but customers ask "are API keys/requests impacted?" can we add "no user data loss" if accurate? Also please call out which endpoints (generation vs embeddings).
aya (oncall): good call. Current assessment: generation endpoints (text & chat) are affected; embeddings stable. No evidence of data loss or compromised requests.
ops-lee: loop in legal for wording on "no data loss" and any compliance phrasing. tagging @legal-jordan.
legal-jordan: quick review: prefer "No customer data has been lost or exfiltrated" and avoid absolutes like "no" unless we can prove. Suggest small tweak to mitigation wording to avoid speculation.
aya (oncall): updated draft with legal edit — prepping publish. ```
We are investigating increased latency and throttling affecting text generation (chat/text) in the us-west region. Some requests may experience delays or transient errors.
Impact: approximately 7–12% of requests to generation endpoints are affected. Embeddings endpoints are operating normally.
Scope: No customer data has been lost or exfiltrated.
Mitigation: scaling the serving pool and temporarily reducing batch sizes to lower queue pressure; autoscaling config being reviewed.
Next update: 30 minutes or sooner.
```
support-maya: LGTM, will prep a support note and customer checklist. Please include the short customer-facing bullet for intercom templates.
product-anna: add a line about expected timeline for rollback to normal ("we expect normal performance within 60–90 minutes if scaling stabilizes").
aya (oncall): added ETA note per @product-anna. Ready to publish when someone clicks go.
ops-lee: +1 from ops. I can hit publish.
incident-bot: STATUSPAGE DRAFT queued for publish. Reviewer: ops-lee.
ops-lee: Publishing now...
ops-lee: Published update (1768010200) — link: https://status.redwood.com/incidents/genqueue-throttle-us-west
support-maya: support note sent to triage and Intercom article updated with messaging.
aya (oncall): monitoring mitigation. Will post next update at 1768012000 or earlier.
incident-bot: AUTO: periodic-check scheduled for 1768012000.
aya (oncall): RESOLVED: Queue pressure relieved after autoscale and worker scaling. Observed error rate back to baseline. Marking resolved.
ops-lee: Resolved notice published (1768010400).
incident-bot: INCIDENT CLOSED. Summary & follow-up runbook tasks to be added to the incident doc. :white_check_mark:
